character: A small sleek person, blue-black feathers with a pale bar on each wing, a nicked beak, head tilted, listening.
wardrobe: A loose grey robe tied with cord, a dozen whistles on strings round the neck, a small hammer in one hand.

full.framing: Full body portrait, front view. Standing in a stone room whose walls are mostly open window frames, wind chimes and bells hanging everywhere.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer.

scene.framing: Tapping the edge of a stone window opening with a small hammer, head cocked, on a windy rooftop of a floating city, chimes swinging around them.
